snippet.title: Pocket Dinos - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
An incremental dino collection game where prehistoric stickers come to life. Hatch eggs, discover unique variants, build thriving habitats, and uncover powerful combinations to grow your fortune.

Now in Early Access: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4715900/Pocket_Dinos/
